title: feat(spec)!: retire the unserved Virtual ObjectQL request protocol (#27028)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBJUwudaPvUtLwcZS3w2akFV)_
Fixes #27028

Ruling-ref: 6472013580
Claim: 6472028553
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — REASON: `skills/**` names none of the retired exports (`git grep` for the 16 names on base: 0 hits; the `_index.md` files point at `data-engine.zod.ts` by its header line, which stays, and `check:generated --fix` left them unchanged). The one hand-written docs page that taught the protocol, `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx`, is corrected in this diff.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 删除 `data-engine.zod.ts` 里没人用的「Virtual ObjectQL」远程请求协议，包括 `DataEngineRequestSchema` 和它的 9 个分支、`DataEngineContractSchema`、5 个类型和 5 个私有辅助。同时登记 10 条 `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR[18]` 和一条 D3 条目 `data-engine-rpc-protocol-retired`，并修好文档页里还在教已退役 `engine.batch?.()` 的段落。
- **为什么改：** 按您在 #27274 上的裁决 A。这套协议在仓内和 hotcrm、objectui、docs.objectos.ai 里都没有读者。按发布出去的样子，它还允许调用方自带 `isSystem`，`execute` 分支能直传原始 SQL，留着就是一个假入口。
- **风险与回滚：** 运行时行为不变。只影响 TypeScript 导入（升级后报 TS2305）和 npm 包里那 10 个 `json-schema/data/DataEngine*Request.json` 文件。回滚就是 revert 本 PR，没有存量数据和 conversion 要处理。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.data-engine-rpc-protocol-retired.ts`、`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts`（第 8 节和第 9 节末尾的说明）、`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine-rpc-protocol-retirement.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** 运行 `git grep -nE 'DataEngine(Find|FindOne|Insert|Update|Delete|Count|Aggregate|Execute|VectorFind)?Request(Schema|Parsed)?\b|DataEngineContractSchema' -- packages ui skills content ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'`，应该只剩退役登记、退役 pin 和说明性注释。
- **需要您做的：** 契约复审 PASS 后，请审批并合并（Tier H）。原因：`docs/adr/0119` 第 61 行锚定的 `DataEngineRequest` 被本 PR 删除，`check:adr-symbol-anchors` 要求修锚。`1a50dca1e` 保留名字，把锚改成文件级锚，并按该 ADR 自己 2026-08-05 的写法补一条带日期的编辑注。ADR 的决定本身没有改动。`skills/*/references/_index.md` 没有变化。

## What changes

- **Spec (`@objectstack/spec`, minor, BREAKING for TypeScript imports and the published JSON Schema files only).** `packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts` loses:
  - the ten request schemas: `DataEngineRequestSchema` and its arms `DataEngine{Find,FindOne,Insert,Update,Delete,Count,Aggregate,Execute,VectorFind}RequestSchema`;
  - `DataEngineContractSchema`;
  - the types `DataEngineRequest`, `DataEngineRequestParsed`, `DataEngineExecuteRequest`, `DataEngineInsertRequest` and `DataEngineVectorFindRequest`;
  - the private helpers `RpcQueryOptionsSchema`, `foldRpcQueryOptions`, `RpcLegacyFilterMixin`, `foldRpcLegacyFilter` and `RPC_WHERE_SLOT`.

  Two in-file notes stand where the block stood: section 8, and the end of section 9 beside the older `DataEngineBatchRequestSchema` note, which they absorb. `RPC_QUERY_ALIAS_SLOTS`, `foldQueryAliasSlots`, `aliasConflictIssue`, every `*OptionsSchema` and the query-transport schemas stay. Route 3 of the `spec-property-retirement` kit (the #27182 and #4618 precedent): no metadata source authors these shapes, so there is no `retiredKey()` tombstone and no D2 conversion.
- **ADR-0087: registered.** Ten `retired-defs/18.data__DataEngine*Request.ts` files, plus the D3 semantic entry `semantic/18.data-engine-rpc-protocol-retired.ts`, which names the doors that exist: `IDataEngine` in process, `ctx.api.object(name)` in a hook or action body, the REST data routes and `POST {basePath}/batch` on the wire. The changeset carries the FROM → TO table and the `registered data-engine-rpc-protocol-retired` marker.
- **Generated and ledgers.** `json-schema.manifest/data.json` loses 10 defs and `authorable-surface/data.json` 35 rows. The build required both deletions, deliberately; `authorable-surface.base.json` is untouched. Further moves: `authorable-defaults/data.json` −1, `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` −8 entries (`measured` totals 252 → 244 schemas, 900 → 892 sites), `unemitted-schemas.baseline.json` −1 (`DataEngineContractSchema`), `docs-import-surface.baseline.json` −6 and `variant-docs.json` −1 (the `method:` union). `api-surface`, `export-origins`, `declaration-map`, the reference page and index (1560 → 1550 schemas), the strictness-ledger counts and `test-typecheck-debt.json` were regenerated.
- **Pins that move.** `data-engine.test.ts` drops the ten request suites, the two integration cases that parsed request literals, and the request rows of the #26954 projection-parity table. `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` drops three `Iso_data_dataEngine__*RequestSchema` rows, and its census goes 799 → 796 (header, title, `toHaveLength` with the history line).
- **New pin.** `packages/spec/src/data/data-engine-rpc-protocol-retirement.test.ts`, listed in `vitest.repo-tests.json`, asserts five things:
  - the ten defs and the D3 entry are registered;
  - the eleven value exports are gone from `/data` and from the root entry;
  - the option bags and `RPC_QUERY_ALIAS_SLOTS` survive (the lit control);
  - nothing in the declared radius still uses a retired name (a tree-scoped absence walk);
  - the matcher catches real uses and ignores neighbours (an anti-vacuity test).
- **Docs and prose.** `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx`:
  - drops the `DataEngineRequest` import and the retired `batch?` member from its `IDataEngine` listing;
  - replaces the copyable `engine.batch?.([...])` example with the real alternatives (`IObjectQLEngine.transaction(cb)`, `batchData` with `options.atomic`, `POST {basePath}/batch`);
  - stops calling the legacy-alias normalizer "the RPC layer".

  Comment-only rewords where the retired names were cited: `contracts/data-engine.ts`, `ui/view-grouping-query.ts`, `data-engine.zod.ts` and `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (`@objectstack/objectql` patch). The two `DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md` rows are struck through.

## Why

The maintainer's ruling A on #27274 (record 6472013580): retire the block rather than keep it as a planned contract. The phase-1 measurement is on the decision card. It found zero readers in this repo outside `packages/spec/src/data/` and zero in hotcrm `353dace`, objectui `b2c0ade` and docs.objectos.ai `cab35fd`, against controls of 311, 2095 and 74 files that import `@objectstack/spec`. The one real cross-VM engine boundary (the QuickJS sandbox) uses a different shape, and the published JSON Schema admitted a caller-supplied `context.isSystem` and a raw-SQL `execute` arm.

## Tests

- New: `data-engine-rpc-protocol-retirement.test.ts`, 16 cases.
- Moved: `data-engine.test.ts` (request suites removed; the option-bag and transport suites are unchanged) and `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` (census 796).

## Acceptance notes

- `scripts/def-key-collisions.test.ts` (`--project repo`) fails locally with `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` before reaching its guard. Its fixture symlinks `packages/spec/node_modules` into a tmp clone, and the pnpm `.bin/tsx` shim resolves a relative path that does not exist there. The failure sits in the fixture's `tsx` resolution, before the guard runs, and this diff touches neither the fixture, `build-schemas.ts` nor `http.zod.ts`. NOT MEASURED locally; `Test Core` runs it.
- `IDataEngine`'s doc comments still mention "remote/virtual engines" as hypothetical implementers that may omit optional members. That is about the TypeScript contract, not the retired protocol, so it is left as is.

## Verification

Base `origin/main` `a0aa8a1f3` (merged in); head `644adb1e7`.

<details><summary>Build and generated artifacts (merged head)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` → exit 0. Before that, the build refused three times as designed: the manifest lines, the `unemitted-schemas` entry and the 8 `dropped-refinements` entries.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` → exit 0, 14 of 14 fresh. No `skills/*/references/_index.md` moved.
</details>

<details><summary>Typecheck and tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` → exit 0 (merged head).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` → Test Files 748 passed (748), Tests 22293 passed | 1 todo (merged head).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo` → 82 of 83 files passed, 1370 of 1371 tests. The one failure is `def-key-collisions.test.ts` (`MODULE_NOT_FOUND`, see Acceptance notes). The new pin passes: 32 of 33 in the targeted re-run on the merged head, the one failure again `def-key-collisions`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` → exit 0, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/objectql^...' build`.
- Full dogfood (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, final head `644adb1e7`, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`): Test Files 348 passed | 3 skipped (351), Tests 2806 passed | 20 skipped (2826). Lock verdict `command-exit 0`.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 111 families)</summary>

- 111 families run; 99 exited 0 on the first pass. The 11 that exited 3 (a prerequisite: dist predated an edited test file) and `check:generated` (stale dist, plus the test-typecheck ledger re-record) were re-run after a rebuild, and all exit 0.
- `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` → ✓ `registered data-engine-rpc-protocol-retired (new here)`.
- `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` → ✓ no `major`; the narrowing ships `minor`.
- `check:spec-parsed-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:variant-docs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:role-word`, `check:liveness`, `check:exported-any`, `check:dual-source-exports` → exit 0.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (CI-owned run).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
